en: You are the one we trust in,
notes: line 1.3: 'falalaʻanga', the place or ground of trust, refuge.
line 1.4: 'Mo e ʻofa ki Tonga', literally 'and the love towards Tonga': God is the one who loves Tonga.
line 1.5: 'ʻafio hifo', 'look down, be present below', the honorific verb used of God and the king.
line 1.7: 'tali homau loto', 'answer (receive) our hearts', i.e. our wishes.
line 1.8: Tupou, the royal line (King George Tupou I when the anthem was written).
